name: Match-3 puzzle (Phaser)
description: Phaser 2D puzzle baseline. Tests the puzzle playbook (tile interaction -> grid permutation -> match clears -> score increments) and the Phaser engine path. Catches 'score never increments' and 'match detection only one axis' regressions.
brief: Create a match-3 puzzle game where tapping two adjacent tiles swaps them and three-in-a-row clears + adds to the score.
